verdict.rationale: Abacum's own marketing says actuals flow live from connected ERPs into one model that also holds forecasts, so finance can update the plan without rebuilding it. That covers the core of the story at a claim level. However, nothing describes how the forecast actually re-baselines after a close, such as closed periods swapping forecast for actuals or a rolling forecast advancing, and there is no hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: documented close-driven re-baselining mechanics (actuals replacing forecast periods, rolling forecast roll-forward), refresh cadence/sync detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, the forecast re-baselines on fresh actuals after each close without rebuilding the model

citations.quote: Connect actuals, assumptions, forecasts, and scenarios in one governed workspace—so finance can update the plan without rebuilding it.
Budgeting and forecasting in one model: top-down targets, bottom-up inputs, live actuals.
Abacum connects pipeline, actuals and capacity in one live model. So the number you take to the board is today's, not last close's.
Abacum builds P&L, balance sheet and cash flow off live actuals from your ERP
